title: Electric Heater
description: The &3Electric Heater&r is a heater which produces heat using electricity. A Screwdriver is needed to increase its energy input, to a maximum of &e5023HE/t&r for &e1000TU/t&r.
&2A single Heating Oven that uses Coal produces the same amount of heat so it is not recomended that this is used.&r
